request.title: Keep nested Settings content and action labels readable on enlarged phones
request.description: Manual review of the current360-pixel200-percent Settings screenshot shows nested card padding leaving glyph-wide action/section areas. Export and upload labels split final letters; private-sync section names lose ordinary-word space. Existing static private-section fixture captures only the inner list and misses owning card geometry.
request.expected_behavior: Use available Settings width for nested cards, private-sync section names and action labels, retaining44-pixel primary targets, exact checkbox labels, all consent/data safeguards and existing information architecture.
request.priority_reason: Changed Settings route naming cannot be accepted with unreadable action labels and section context. Separate frozen Settings section-navigation task owns information architecture.
